_doc_priority: CraftTweaker scripts override these settings. CRT takes priority.

_doc_fields.id: Unique ritual ID. Auto-prepends 'adversity:' if no colon present.
_doc_fields.inputs: Array of input items: [{item, count, meta(optional)}]. Single or multiple.
_doc_fields.output: Output item: {item, count, meta(optional)}. Omit or null for command-only.
_doc_fields.required_stage: Stage required to perform. null = no requirement.
_doc_fields.reward_stage: Stage granted upon completion. null = no reward.
_doc_fields.category: Category for display. Auto-guessed if omitted.
_doc_fields.effect: Ritual effect ID for special effects (e.g. adversity:purge_curse).
_doc_fields.effect_params: Parameters for the effect (depends on effect type).
